name: dry-well
unmodelled: v1 note: The Dry Well (Khô Tỉnh), Nguyen Anh, foreseen. fight_calc.py is the pre-#44 model (CONSTANT_DRIFT 31 of 60), so its numbers are observations only; the sheet's verdicts use the paper model in dry-well.sheet.md § Fight Results. Old-model shapes: Cold hits are kind qi, Force hits kind body; the build's ward is a drain ward shaped like the top-end fixture at ws 150, we 100. Ice stacks are approximated by a cost_raise curse (capped at +50 % by the old curse cap; the real stacks are uncapped). regen_bonus_pct -2 sets the old regen_base 0.02 to 0, which is Water Table's close.
Cold Toll (identity): Ice stacks raise the enemy's drain bills against your hits and ticks; its close halves Ice's art-cost raise
Ice element debuff stacks (+3.9 % art cost each, x1.234 purity, +50 % stack effect, no cap); approximated by a +50 % cost_raise curse
Owed Water: burn and unpaid bills past an empty pool become debt (cap 40 % of the enemy's maximum); their regeneration repays it, half to you
Water Table (enabler): 30 % of the bills the enemy's drain wards pay against your hits restore your linh luc (its close, no regeneration, is modelled)
Frost Tithe: 9 % of the extra art cost your Ice stacks make the enemy pay restores your linh luc
Still Water: linh luc lost to a full pool heals at half
Weighted Bucket (+30 % drain bills against your hits and ticks)
Cracked Clay: L5 +4 per 10 of your Ice stacks on the target, cap +20
Spring at the Well's Mouth (heal art, slot 6, refunds its cost when it heals)
Mountain Screen and Thousand-Layer Cloud ward shields (reserved, about 6,110 points at ws 150); only their reservation is modelled
#44 defence: resistance in points, drain rates scaled by ws and we, kept resistance that survives an empty pool
Dry Riverbed's 40 % Physical part; Drowning Palm's Force penetration +300 points

_comment: Migrated from fight_calc.py format v1 by tools/design/combat_sim/migrate_fight_v1.py (2026-11-11). Art kinds: qi -> elem, body -> phys, no element stacks. Costs kept (post-#44 file).
